title: D6: signature container JWS (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option B: objects verified outside an MLS group are signed with JWS (RFC 7515) using the detached / unencoded payload option (RFC 7797, b64=false) over the exact body bytes; EdDSA/Ed25519 (RFC 8037). Inside groups the MLS sender signature suffices.
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-16 and applied in spec (13, 05, 06, 11, 14, profiles of jmap family)
